params.topic: Veikkausliiga exact 868-fixture pre-match context evidence completion
params.execution_note: Corrective unique request after req-20261028-002 returned 1,902 rows and a request hash that does not match its current request file. Use only the attached exact 868-row identity artifact. Artifact SHA-256: 9de8b8fac5fcdebbc51e1df99f9a5fe329e3149f3deacc2dfcc4105cd9a4c093. The artifact is committed in this ai-data-bus repository at work-req-20261028-003/fixture_identity_input.csv. Do not substitute the 1,902-row superset, do not infer missing identity rows, and do not use odds or post-match data.
questions: For each exact fixture_key in the attached artifact, return exactly one row; preserve identity fields byte-for-byte and do not add fixtures. Crosswalk accepted pre-existing response req-20261006-004 for 2019-2025 first, then provide only missing or weakly sourced fields.

Return official_round and double_round_robin with source-backed season semantics. Return meeting_number only when an authoritative source explicitly defines it or the exact pairing is joined to sourced official round records. Otherwise preserve null and state unavailable; never infer from order/date/score/standings/market data.

Return actual matchday venue and city, WGS84 longitude/latitude, IANA timezone, home/away official club identity and lineage fields (natal_year and competition_entry_year), and official local kickoff with timezone semantics. Preserve source spelling, neutral/moved/conflict/unavailable statuses and competing values.

For every non-null value provide field-level source_url, final_url, retrieved_at with timezone, field_locator, source_name, source_value, and SHA-256 of captured source evidence bytes. A hash of URL or prose is not an evidence hash. Return rows for unavailable fields with attempted sources and next actions.

Return expected/discovered/complete/partial/conflict/unavailable/blocked/missing counts by season and total, plus unresolved_queue keyed by fixture_key. Provide row artifact path/schema/count/SHA-256 and confirm the input artifact SHA-256 before processing.

Only source-backed pre-match facts and provenance. Exclude odds, scores, results, standings, Qimen/chart output, interpretation, direction, probability, Snapshot, Outcome, Review, and Gold. Do not write into project files or formal records.
